music.title: 乘风之前
music.prompt: Instrumental game menu music for a joyful mythological sky racing adventure. Bright marimba and soft plucked harp, warm rounded synth bass, airy sparkling arpeggios, light crisp breakbeat, memorable playful melody, relaxed anticipation and floating islands. Steady 112 BPM, D major, four four time. Clean spacious game mix, short intro, continuous groove, no ending, no vocals, no choir, no speech.

music.title: 神使坡道 · 云上疾驰
music.prompt: Instrumental high speed arcade racing game soundtrack, sunny floating Greek temples and winged messenger sprinting downhill. Energetic tight breakbeat drums at 160 BPM, funky clean electric bass, sparkling harp runs, bright analog synth lead with a catchy original heroic melody, light orchestral stabs and breezy uplifting chords. Playful buoyant momentum, polished clear rhythm, D major, four four time. Full groove from the start, steady intensity for a continuous gameplay loop, no long intro, no ending, no vocals or speech.
